Subject: Field lab proposal — QueryNest + EdgeCraft (draft agenda attached)

Hi Monica / Vivek,

Great to connect at AI Stack Week — thanks again for the quick discussion. EdgeCraft and QueryNest are excited to propose a joint hands-on field lab focused on real-world retrieval+inference patterns for enterprise search. Attached is a draft agenda (QN-EdgeCraft-Agenda-v2.pdf) and a short runbook. High-level goals:

- Walk customers through Redwood inference tuning and QueryNest embedding/rerank flow
- Live lab: participants run a small dataset through the pipeline and compare cost/latency profiles
- Collateral: short blog recap + co-branded recording for lead gen

Dates we’re targeting: week of June 21–25 or July 12–16 (flexible). Estimated headcount: 35–50. Can you confirm Redwood interest and whether we should loop in marketing for a co-branded landing page?

Attachments: QN-EdgeCraft-Agenda-v2.pdf

Cheers,
Sara Kim
Partnerships Director, EdgeCraft Consulting
